propositions: The workflow editor presents authored YAML/BPMN without trustworthy visibility of effective criteria policy derived from built-ins and project overlays.
A read-only Effective Policy view must expose the snapshot-derived criteria policy without allowing edits that would create a second policy authority.
New project code-review LLM criteria must validate that applies_to contains non-empty repository-relative glob patterns; missing or empty globs are rejected with remedy suggestion.
Save validation and snapshot compilation errors must fail loud with actionable messages and prevent persistence of invalid workflow without silent fallback to defaults.
Authored Workflow must round-trip byte-equivalent while Effective Policy view reflects only snapshot changes, with no trace data or secrets in editor payloads.
